name: mtg-goldfish-sim
description: Goldfish simulator for Commander decks (shared engine + one folder per deck).

scripts.pod: npm run -s build && node --enable-source-maps dist/sim.js pod
scripts.cards: npm run -s build && node --enable-source-maps dist/sim.js cards
scripts.logs: npm run -s build && node --enable-source-maps dist/sim.js logs
scripts.app: npm run -s build && npm --prefix app/web run -s build && node --enable-source-maps dist/sim.js app
